# Weekly baking schedule

Settled into a rhythm that fits around a normal work week instead of fighting it.

- **Friday evening**: mix the dough, autolyse while doing the dishes
- **Friday night**: bulk ferment on the counter, stretch-and-folds every 30 minutes for the first two
- **Saturday morning**: shape, into a banneton, straight into the fridge
- **Saturday–Sunday**: cold retard, anywhere from 12 to 36 hours depending on the weekend's plans
- **Whenever**: bake straight from the fridge, no need to bring it back to room temperature first

Doughlores gets its last pre-bake feed on Friday afternoon so it peaks right when the evening mix
happens. See the starter log for what happens when that timing slips.
